description: A toy company can build two factory types, a medium sized factory and a small factory. A medium sized factory can make 50 toys per day and requires 3 operators. A small factory can make 35 toys per day and requires 2 operators. The company must make at least 250 toys per day but they only have available 16 operators. How many of each factory should the company build to minimize the total number of factories?

ProductionRate.definition: Production rate of each factory type (toys per day)

OperatorRequirement.definition: Number of operators required for each factory type

TotalProductionRequirement.definition: Minimum number of toys required per day

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of factories (medium and small) built"

constraints.description: The total daily production from all factories must be at least TotalProductionRequirement (250 toys per day)
The total number of operators required by all factories must not exceed TotalAvailableOperators (16 operators)
The number of factories built for each factory type must be a non-negative integer

NumFactories.definition: Number of factories to build for each factory type
